verdict.rationale: Navan's docs confirm expense management, reimbursements, card-transaction tracking, and receipt handling all live in one platform/API (navan-docs-4, navan-docs-8, navan-docs-9, navan-docs-2), which supports the idea that bookings, card spend, and receipts feed into a unified expense record. However, no evidence explicitly describes the automatic reconciliation/matching process or confirms reports are directly itinerary-linked. Missing for 10: explicit description of automatic receipt-to-transaction matching, confirmation that reports auto-link to specific trip itineraries, and independent/hands-on evidence of this consolidation working end-to-end.
